newsitem.title: UK: Abbey National to issue $200 mln pref shrs.
newsitem.headline: Abbey National to issue $200 mln pref shrs.

text.p: Abbey National Plc will issue a $200 million undated preference share issue on or around November 12, it said in a statement on Wednesday.
The preference shares will pay a non-cumulative fixed gross dividend which will be determined at the time of issue.
The issue will be managed by Merrill Lynch.

"Up until now UK banks which have not had a U.S. presence have effectively been unable to access tier one capital in the U.S. We have developed a structure which gives free access to the U.S. preference share market for the first time," said Gareth Jones, managing director of Abbey National's treasury and wholesale banking at
"(We) aim to make our first issue at this time due to the favourable prevailing markets," Jones said.
